features.title: Order milestones
features.body: Celebrate 100, 500, 1,000 orders and beyond. Owners and admins get a celebration screen when a milestone is reached.

features.title: Share to Story
features.body: Turn a milestone into a ready-made 1080 x 1920 card with your business name and storefront link, and share it in one tap.

features.title: Replay any time
features.body: Settings > System > Replay milestone celebration plays your latest milestone again.

fixes: Settings icons now use the Fyll lime colour everywhere.
Home tiles are plain in light mode instead of tinted.
Buttons on the start page use the Fyll display font.

features.title: Settings, reorganised
features.body: A new Settings sidebar groups everything, with search and an All features page where you can switch tools on or off.

features.title: Fulfillment Timelines
features.body: Order timelines and shipping zones are now one setting. Pick the states each timeline covers.

features.title: Fresh look for Tasks and Settings
features.body: Tasks, Settings and both sidebars now match the new Fyll style on web and mobile.

fixes: WhatsApp alerts are now one per order: Fyll Checkout and Social Checkout send a payment alert, Storefront sends an order alert, and approving a payment sends nothing.
Orders you add by hand no longer send a WhatsApp alert.

features.title: Better payment links
features.body: Customers now pay in three clear steps: details, pay, then receipt. You also get their contact details before they pay.

features.title: Mark as received
features.body: Customer paid but never uploaded a receipt? Confirm the payment yourself from the payment page or the ⋮ menu.

features.title: Payments on Home
features.body: Staff now see their latest payments, and a pending chip shows payments waiting from the last 3 days.

features.title: New partner portal
features.body: The partner portal has a fresh look, jobs and bills grouped by day, and notifications settings.

fixes: Staff no longer see stock value; they see total units in stock instead.
Unread badges on Threads, Cases and the bell no longer pile up from old or closed threads.
Mark all read now stays marked, with a confirmation.
Social Checkout orders no longer send a repeat new order or new storefront order alert after the payment alert.
Order headers now show where an order really came from.
Customer names are capitalised consistently across orders, payments and Home.
Bills under Partners are hidden from staff.

features.title: Faster Fyll Checkout approvals
features.body: Approving a storefront payment now finishes right away while the rest syncs in the background.

features.title: Custom items go to inventory
features.body: Items you add on the fly in an order are saved to your inventory so you can reuse them.

features.title: A fresher Home
features.body: New Payments collected card, quicker Jump to tiles and a cleaner Needs you today.

fixes: Storefront payments now show as paid in Fyll Ops once the order is approved.
WooCommerce fields are hidden when WooCommerce is not connected.
Page headers, tabs and empty states now look the same across Payments, Delivery, Returns and Partners.
The active item in the left menu is now Fyll lime.
